    Plot a distance-decay map

    plot_DD_map.Rd

    Creates a map of a distance-decay raster and optionally crops the map around a colony location.

    Usage

    plot_DD_map(
  DD_map,
  colony = NULL,
  km_to_left = 30,
  km_to_right = 50,
  km_up = 30,
  km_down = 70,
  crop = FALSE,
  title = "Distance-decay map"
)

    Arguments

    DD_map

    A raster::RasterLayer object containing distance-decay values.

    colony

    An sf point object containing the colony location. This is required when crop = TRUE and must use a projected coordinate reference system with coordinates measured in metres.

    km_to_left

    Non-negative numeric scalar giving the distance, in kilometres, to extend the cropped area west of the colony. Defaults to 30.

    km_to_right

    Non-negative numeric scalar giving the distance, in kilometres, to extend the cropped area east of the colony. Defaults to 50.

    km_up

    Non-negative numeric scalar giving the distance, in kilometres, to extend the cropped area north of the colony. Defaults to 30.

    km_down

    Non-negative numeric scalar giving the distance, in kilometres, to extend the cropped area south of the colony. Defaults to 70.

    crop

    Logical scalar indicating whether DD_map should be cropped around colony. Defaults to FALSE.

    title

    Character string giving the plot title. Defaults to "Distance-decay map".

    Value

    A ggplot2::ggplot() object showing the distance-decay raster.

    Details

    When crop = FALSE, the complete raster is plotted.

    When crop = TRUE, colony must be supplied. The plotting extent is calculated using the four directional distances. These distances are converted from kilometres to metres, so the colony and raster must use a projected coordinate reference system with coordinates measured in metres.

    See also

    plot_DD_map_with_ORDs() for adding ORD footprints and buffer zones.

    Other plotting functions: plot_BirdFlightMap(), plot_DBS_map(), plot_DD_map_with_ORDs(), plot_ORD_obstruction(), plot_ORDpoly(), plot_adult_body_mass(), plot_brddata(), plot_calibration_outputs(), plot_chick_survival(), plot_colony_location(), plot_flight_distance(), plot_fltdist_base(), plot_frgcompdata(), plot_seamask()

    Examples

    if (FALSE) {
# Plot the complete distance-decay map
plot_DD_map(DD_map)

# Plot the map cropped around a colony
plot_DD_map(
  DD_map = DD_map,
  colony = colony,
  crop = TRUE
)
}
